answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet thus collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the crystal graph is rebuilt each epoch, the meadow merge is applied at settlement and the yarrow audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 42 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 8 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
